name: Riko
source:
"Let Riko help you release the magic!"

The mysterious dog-eared girl who attacks Hayato. Actually a "Goddess Substitute". She enjoys mischief and speaks ambiguously manipulating Hayato effortlessly. Having a unique fondness for scents, she likes to 'sniff' bandages that have absorbed Hayato's magic.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294690/Yomegami_My_Sweet_Goddess/]Steam[/url]]
